parsed.note: The proposal only tunes TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE (a normal training hyperparameter) and keeps TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9', leaving the fixed evaluation (EVAL_SPLIT, EVAL_TOKENS, EVAL_SHARD) untouched, so val_bpb still measures real model quality.
